request.description: Categories for an entity type (`msme` or `individual`) with lender availability; categories without a live lender route say `Not Yet Available In Your Area`. Compat layer for the current app (plan §10.3): the app sets `EXPO_PUBLIC_API_URL=<host>/v0`. The case is the borrower's newest open application, resolved server side because the app never sends one. Removed once the app moves to `/v1`.

response.name: 200 OK
